Essential facts about my software engineering specialization, dual degree academic background, and hiring availability.

Steven Amin (Steven Amin Ramzy Nashed) is a final-year Software Engineering student at Ain Shams University in a dual-degree program with the University of East London (expected graduation: 2027), based in Cairo, Egypt. He develops backend and full-stack applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, React, and SQL Server.

Steven's primary backend stack includes C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API and MVC, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and SQL Server (T-SQL), alongside PostgreSQL exposure. On the frontend, he builds with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Vite. He also has practical experience with UiPath RPA workflows and Python projects.

Steven completed a Deployment Intern program at the National Bank of Egypt (5–30 July 2026), gaining internship exposure to the enterprise release lifecycle across SIT, UAT, and production environments, deployment coordination, and change requests. He also completed Full-Stack .NET Developer training through the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI) and Python training with Sprints.

Steven is currently pursuing a B.Sc. in Computer Science (Software Engineering Major) at Ain Shams University (2023–2027 expected, current CGPA: 3.22 / 4.0) alongside a dual-degree B.Sc. in Software Engineering with the University of East London (2024–2027 expected). Both degrees are currently in progress.

Steven is interested in 2027 graduate software engineering roles, internships, and suitable freelance projects (on-site or hybrid in Cairo, Egypt, as well as remote roles). He can be reached directly at stevenameen02@gmail.com.
